change.after: "lowest MTU of all external interfaces is used"

original.statement: Cilium MTU auto-detection now uses the lowest MTU of all external interfaces instead of only the primary interface (ENI secondary interfaces excluded); manual MTU configuration still works.

change.after: "the lowest MTU of all external interfaces"

corrected.statement: Cilium MTU auto-detection now uses the lowest MTU of all external interfaces; before, only the primary interface was considered. In ENI mode, secondary interfaces are not considered.

decision.reason: The subject and change type are right. [ev-b37407b60520] says MTU auto-detection "will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces" where "before, only the primary interface was considered". That is the same configuration with different meaning, so behavior-changed applies, and protocol-behavior "mtu-auto-detection" is built from the evidence's own key words. The proposed "after" value paraphrases the text by adding "is used", and both values are wrapped in extra quotes. I have replaced them with the exact wording from the evidence.
